sources.title: Suppressing Quantum Circuit Errors Due to System Variability
sources.finding: The paper ranks postcompilation circuit placements using calibration-derived costs.
sources.local_inference: Rank compiled W tree candidates, including single-qubit multiplicity and intermediate-state noise sensitivity. Test the challenge score separately; paper fidelity results do not establish gains here.

sources.title: Short-Depth Circuits for Dicke State Preparation
sources.finding: The authors give ancilla-free grid constructions with depth O(sqrt(nk)) and O(nk) gates.
sources.local_inference: Prefer explicit routed divide-and-conquer circuits as resource benchmarks. Asymptotic improvements do not establish a native-moment win at N<=15.

sources.title: A Divide-and-Conquer Approach to Dicke State Preparation
sources.finding: The approach distributes Hamming weight between blocks and then applies coherent Dicke unitaries within blocks.
sources.local_inference: Use peer unary-to-Dicke isometries only for their certified input-count ranges; complete-state fidelity alone does not certify a reusable coherent decoder.

next_hypothesis: A first-order estimate of each valid Z-string probability may rank circuits better than global state fidelity, since the score penalizes nonuniform valid outcomes. Derive channel insertion contributions with backward-evolved projectors; verify against scaled-noise density matrices before using for selection.
status: hypothesis; not implemented or claimed as an improvement
